summary: Frontend-only responsive layout refactor testing (iteration 9). Executed against admin login on desktop (1440x900), forced mobile/tablet/tv via ?forceBp= override, and real 400x800 mobile viewport. All 17 listed acceptance items verified. Backend smoke: /api/status and /api/radios both require auth (401 unauth as expected).

issues: Header title 'DMR TRACKER / HOMEBREW MASTER · MULTI-BRAND GPS' wraps across ~4 lines consuming ~130px of vertical space — could be more compact on mobile.

action_items: MINOR/OPTIONAL: The PR description states localStorage keys are `panel:dash:leftOpen`, `panel:dash:rightOpen`, `panel:dash:bottomOpen`. Actual keys used in code are `dash:leftOpen`, `dash:rightOpen`, `dash:bottomOpen` (Dashboard.jsx L91-93 calls `usePersistedState('dash:leftOpen', ...)` and usePersistedState stores the key verbatim, unlike CollapsiblePanel which prefixes with 'panel:'). Persistence works correctly; only the naming diverges from the spec. Consider aligning either the spec or the code.
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard.jsx is ~745 lines — still under 800 but growing; consider splitting DesktopLayout/NarrowLayout/OpsPanels into sibling files.
usePersistedState currently defined inside CollapsiblePanel.jsx but consumed from Dashboard.jsx — fine, but a small /hooks/usePersistedState.js would be a cleaner separation.

The mobile-menu button relies on Tailwind `md:hidden` (CSS media query at 768px) rather than the JS `bp` value; using `?forceBp=mobile` on a >=768 viewport will show the mobile tabbar (JS-driven) but hide the mobile-menu button (CSS-driven). Not a bug on real devices but the forceBp escape hatch is inconsistent — consider gating with `narrow` from the hook.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: desktop data-breakpoint='desktop' with left+right columns, roster-list scrollable (sh=994, ch=683, scrollTop=250 accepted), collapse/expand left/right/bottom buttons all toggle correctly and persist to localStorage keys `dash:leftOpen`, `dash:rightOpen`, `dash:bottomOpen`. panel-channels + panel-channels-header collapse toggles and persists to `panel:channels`. tab-messages renders msg-conversation. document.documentElement/body have no vertical overflow. Mobile (?forceBp=mobile OR viewport 400x800): data-breakpoint='mobile', mobile-tabbar with all 5 tabs (mtab-map/roster/ops/msg/log) present. mtab-roster shows roster-list scrollable (sh=994 ch=687). mtab-msg shows msg-conversation. mtab-ops shows panel-channels + overlay-manager. mobile-menu opens mobile-menu-drawer (only visible at CSS <768). Tablet: data-breakpoint='tablet' + mobile-tabbar. TV: data-breakpoint='tv' with left-column + right-column. Only findings are minor: (1) localStorage naming mismatch between PR description and code, (2) mobile-menu CSS-hidden on wide-viewport forceBp=mobile.
